channel.description: Learn natural Japanese at a comfortable, slow pace! Each episode features real-life Japanese conversations, essential vocabulary, and practical phrases designed for JLPT N5-N4 beginners. Watch the full video with furigana subtitles and download free PDF scripts on YouTube and our website.
